newsitem.title: FRANCE: Three Italians, one Frenchman die in French Alps.
newsitem.headline: Three Italians, one Frenchman die in French Alps.

text.p: Three Italian mountain climbers plunged 800 metres (2,500 feet) to their deaths in the Mont Blanc mountain range on Monday, rescue workers said.
In a separate accident, a French parachutist crashed into the side of a mountain at a height of 2,800 metres (9,000 feet) in the northern Alps and died from his injuries.
The two accidents occurred a day after two French youths were killed when they fell from a mountain near Mont Blanc.
